main.description: A channel's configuration. Lives at key 'self' in the channel's own space. The space type says whether it is a text or voice channel, and the space key is the channel's identity.

migratedFrom.description: Set on a channel created by migrating a repo-backed community. Points at the legacy channel record whose history is served alongside this channel.
